tier: T1-kin (self-action OPEN loop; m=10, causal bucket, dead-reckoned nav, logged scene, periodic; plain arms); R-T0 at T0 (box 2's standard eval). Never 'closed loop'; the lead follows its logged future.
estimator: taniteval.ci.paired_episode_cluster_bootstrap, B=2000, seed 0, 141 episodes (2,399 windows), per seed, paired. It answers 'would another draw of EPISODES say this?'; the training-seed question is answered by the two seeds (H-ESTIM-SEED-1: no replicate arm was trained, so a separated row is a result about one training run per seed); the planner is deterministic.
four_families: ADE6 + LONGITUDINAL / LATERAL / TACTICAL / STRATEGIC rows of Read A, per seed (never pooled); STRATEGIC is reported, not paused for v8F
